title: A single affine stage suffices for continuity
statement: Assume affine continuity in all degrees: for every system described in [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology-stage-continuity] with every $D_i$ affine, its supplied cohomology cocone $B$ is a colimit. Then every affine scheme $S$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] satisfies $C(S)$ of [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology-stage-continuity]. In particular only one specified affine stage is required; earlier stages need not be affine.

source.place: Tag 09YQ (theorem-colimit), agent-written finite-cover reduction of the parent; Tag 0A50 (lemma-mayer-vietoris) for binary gluing.

proof.text: Take J = {i : I | i₀ ≤ i}. It is nonempty because it contains i₀; an upper bound of i and j in I is again in J. The inclusion t is final by Monotone.final_functor_iff: a common upper bound of any i and i₀ lies in the image above i. Its opposite is initial; Functor.Initial.isLimitWhiskerEquiv and Functor.Final.isColimitWhiskerEquiv give the restricted scheme limit and sheaf colimit.

Transport IsAffine across the supplied isomorphism D(i₀) ≅ S using IsAffine.of_isIso. For each j in J, the scheme transition D(j) → D(i₀) is affine. Apply isAffine_of_isAffineHom to conclude that every restricted stage is affine. Compactness, quasi-separatedness and affine transition instances restrict directly.

Use reindex_etale_transition_coherence for the restricted identity and composition laws, and reindex_etale_comparison_coherence for the sheaf-map, cohomology-map and comparison-leg equations. Their data are actual restrictions with reflexive equality transports, not chosen existence witnesses.
Apply the supplied affine continuity hypothesis to t.op ⋙ D and the concrete restricted data. It gives IsColimit(B.whisker t). Apply Functor.Final.isColimitWhiskerEquiv t B to obtain IsColimit B.
